# R5.37 — Task-mixture sensitivity, sharp-null families and tails

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/207_R5.37__taskstats.md` (seq 207/246) · §3/§4
of `docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` (s3 missingness/tails/
uncertainty; s4 bootstrap/sign-flip/Holm paragraph) · methods packet
M-D · **Requirement ids:** REQ-D-008 (primary) · REQ-D-109,
REQ-D-310, REQ-E-209, REQ-H-010 (contributing) · **Landing record:**
ADR-0415

## Summary

Lands the M-D **task-mixture sensitivity estimator, sharp-null
family machinery and effect tails** on `hharness-eval` plus the
routed kind through `hh-analysis`/`hh-embed` (no RPC, no schema
source, no new dependency, no new event class, no store/dispatch
authority). `crates/hh-eval/src/task_mixture.rs` (new,
`task-mixture/1`) computes over the R5.15
`population::contrast_bounds` per-task cells — one counting rule,
never a second resolution: per-task paired deltas → declared-draws
seeded **whole-task bootstrap** (`BCa` iff T ≥ 30, `Percentile`
below; 2,000-draw confirmatory floor; a declared method
contradicting the floor refuses), **sharp-null sign flip** only
under the registered `lane_randomization` exchangeability (exact
enumeration T ≤ 20; seeded 8,000-draw Monte Carlo +1 above),
**frozen-family Holm** at α = .05 retaining unavailable members
across split reports plus a **separate exploratory BH** member, and
**signed/absolute tails** (nearest-rank P99 may equal the observed
max — labelled never-a-population-bound; clustered-resampling tail
uncertainty where valid). `stats::bootstrap_paired_with` carries
the additive declared-draws parameter — `bootstrap_paired`
delegates at the frozen 4,000, so declared draws drive the actual
resample stream (changed draws ⇒ changed body + report identity,
never a silent constant). The closed `TaskMixtureError` vocabulary
types every refused inference — one task (raw observations only),
unresolved/unpaired/short cells, degenerate resample, floor/draws
violations, shared-shock dependence, weak-mean/practical-margin
nulls, unadmitted exchangeability, omnibus/TOST verdict uses,
malformed family identity, metadata-only declarations, unselected
strata. `hh-analysis` routes kind `task_mixture_sensitivity`
through `analyze` → `analyze_and_record` → persisted
`analysis_report_body/1` (`AnalysisError::TaskMixture` + the
`record_kind` member); `hh-embed` extends the R5.16/16b bound-
`ExperimentView` fold and strict-integer param gate to the new
kind. `tests/r5_37.rs` (7/7) drives the routed battery — every
positive leg hand-checked, a 12-leg refusal table, the 29/30 BCa
boundary, the >20 MC sign-flip, split-report Holm stability, and
draws→computation identity. Predecessor contracts consumed
unchanged (R5.15 population, R5.16 route/refusals, R5.36
mechanisms); $0 spend; offline only.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**2,058 changed source/test lines vs the ≤950 trigger (~2.2×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`cec2367f` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.37-split-review.md`):
the M-D packet binds the whole slice to one scope sentence (no
contingency; the packet family writes contingencies verbatim where
intended) with the keep-together rule — "common task
clusters/family routing are one shared decision" (M-D :89). The
D.2 estimator-vs-routing owner map names `finite_manifest_contrast*`
only — consumed by R5.16/16b. `task_mixture()` is one function
emitting one report member — the proposed estimator-vs-route cut
is mid-predicate and BOTH legs stay over trigger (estimator ~1,029
src alone; battery+route ~1,037); `task_mixture.rs` has zero
`#[cfg(test)]`, so an estimator-first leg lands with zero
fails-without regression (the R5.32/R5.14b-rejected
impl-vs-battery cut). Honest trip: review, not redesign.
